meta.name: Got Milf Sketch Comedy Special
meta.description: got milf? is a female driven sketch comedy special that shines a light on the deep dark crevices  of the female psyche. MILF is a sexualized term for women in their 30's-50's. It is a limited description of a  woman's worth. Through these sketches, ‘got milf?' likes to mess with peoples perceptions of "sexy" and  showcase women as complex and interesting humans by focusing on the humour in the everyday life  occurrences and sometimes ridiculous situations women find themselves in.
meta.slogan: Think Molly Shannon meets Baroness Von Sketch while shadowing Betty White.
